caption: The drawing features a single dark brown ceramic pitcher with a handle on the right side, positioned against a plain, light background. The body of the pitcher is cylindrical, widening slightly towards the top, and it has a small spout on the upper left edge. The exterior surface of the pitcher displays a raised design in a lighter, earthy brown color, which appears to depict a stag with large antlers and some surrounding foliage or tree-like elements. The interior of the pitcher is a pale, off-white color with subtle speckling. The handle is also textured and colored in the same dark brown as the body, with the lighter accents continuing along it. The artist's signature, "Carl Burgsmiss," is written in small, neat letters at the lower right of the drawing.
title: Wide Top Jug or Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
